description.paragraph1: I'm Salvador Campello, journalist and director of TeleElx, where I lead the editorial strategy and coordinate rigorous, contextual and local news coverage.
description.paragraph2: I'm also a lecturer in the Audiovisual Communication area at the Miguel Hernández University, teaching subjects on production, directing, technology and multiplatform storytelling.
description.paragraph3: My TV career as a presenter has allowed me to specialise in live directing and anchoring, team coordination and strategic design of audiovisual content.

Curriculum.clipboardbiography:
Salvador Campello Iborra is a journalist, communicator and university lecturer. His link with the media began very early: at the age of 14 he started his career in local radio, a passion that would shape his professional path. During his university years he received the award for the best student-produced radio show at the Miguel Hernández University station, a recognition that consolidated his commitment to quality communication.

He holds a degree in Journalism from the Miguel Hernández University, where he also completed a Master's in Journalism Innovation, expanding his specialisation in the development of new formats and audiovisual narratives. In addition, he undertook an Erasmus stay in Italy and a period in New York, experiences that enriched his international vision and approach to communication and media.

Despite his youth, Salvador has built a solid career that has led him to become director of TeleElx, the city's leading local television. He is also a presenter of news programmes and special live broadcasts, making his voice and style a reference for the Elche audience.

He combines this role with teaching at the Miguel Hernández University, where he teaches radio, television, audiovisual technology and content production, training future journalists and communicators. He is also a member of the Misteri d'Elx Institutional Chair, contributing to the dissemination and preservation of one of the city's main cultural heritages.

Throughout his career, he has participated in various projects linked to audiovisual innovation, promoting new ways of informing and connecting with citizens. His profile combines training, experience, versatility and commitment to Elche and its environment, standing out as one of the most recognisable and respected voices in the local media landscape.
